text: GoldenPark.pt is operated in Portugal by Azartia Games, S.A.: the regulator SRIJ announced Azartia Games, S.A., under the Golden Park brand, as the new online betting and gaming operator in Portugal, through the website www.goldenpark.pt.
short: GoldenPark.pt is run by Azartia Games, S.A. (SRIJ).

source.name: SRIJ - Serviço de Regulação e Inspeção de Jogos: Azartia Games é a nova entidade exploradora a operar em Portugal
source.quote: A Azartia Games, S.A., com a marca Golden Park, é a nova entidade exploradora de jogos e apostas online a operar em Portugal, através do website www.goldenpark.pt.

additionalSources.name: Jogo Responsável: Operadores Licenciados (GOLDENPARK)
additionalSources.quote: AZARTIA GAMES, S.A. Marca: GoldenPark Website: www.goldenpark.pt
additionalSources.note: The licensed-operators list kept with the SRIJ framework shows Azartia Games, S.A. as the entity behind the GoldenPark brand and www.goldenpark.pt, holding SRIJ licences 029 and 030.
